inputs.commit_message: export verified ASOL stage 2 files read only
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/hesham/gova
verified=826946fc
git -C "$root" cat-file -e "$verified^{commit}"
echo ASOL_STAGE2_FILES_BEGIN
git -C "$root" diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r "$verified"
echo ASOL_STAGE2_FILES_END
while IFS= read -r f; do
  case "$f" in .agent-control/requests/*) continue ;; esac
  echo "ASOL_FILE_BEGIN:$f"
  git -C "$root" show "$verified:$f"
  echo "ASOL_FILE_END:$f"
done < <(git -C "$root" diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r "$verified")
